notes.title: We're changing everything.
notes.content:
We are currently reworking the whole game! New engine, new possibilities!

Main changes in the game:

Changing game engine.
New lore and storyline.
Unique battle system.
New, fresh graphics.
New ost and sfx sounds.
Quest system.
Releasing the whole game, not only Part I.
Many more new functions!


We are currently in the early development phase. The game will be expanded systematically, so be patient! Send your suggestions, which - if we like them - will be implemented in the game. Thank you in advance for all your comments that help us improve the game.

Favorable winds, Players!
Casen and the rest of the developer team.

The photos in the announcement's miniature are only concept arts and it does not represent the final product.

notes.title: "Part I 1.1.1" Update!
notes.content:
Part I 1.1.1 is now available on Steam!


In this update, we fixed some minor bugs and graphical details that could adversely affect the gameplay experience.

In addition, from now on, macOS users will be able to download and play the game (without installing additional programs that open Windows .exe files).

If you have any problems with opening the application on macOS, please report it to casen.help@gmail.com.

notes.title: Version "Part I 1.1" Update!
notes.content:
Version Part I 1.1 is now available on Steam!

In this small update some minor bugs have been fixed. Additionality the "Settings" option has been added to the main menu of the game.

notes.title: The premiere is here!
notes.content:
A Legend of Wisdom Part I is now available to you!

Explore a new world and solve the mystery of the Kingdom of Wisdom! Good luck, Traveler!
